enabled_scope: artifacts the flagged profile owner authored or authorized
personal presentations made by or about the declared profile owner
personal case studies, reports, and authored pages explicitly marked as that owner's work
activation.default_without_flag: brand-neutral; do not import any profile's typography, palette, materiality, voice, or exclusions

A.source: prior Taste skill and existing demo-showcase

B.declaration: required and complete before any design decision

redundancy: distinct position, pattern, or line style
axis, rule, total, baseline, or reference mark

dashboard.job: Reveal overall state, change, exception, and next action within five seconds.

decision_memo.job: Help an executive decide whether to prioritize billing clarity and response time.
decision_memo.format: five-slide PPTX plus full-size PNG renders
requirements: one primary chromatic emphasis per slide
every element a native editable object

personal_landing.job: Present Subscriber Feedback as evidence of the author's analytical practice, not as a fictional SaaS product.
requirements: no fabricated clients, testimonials, or conversion claims

case_study_report.job: Explain question, data, method, findings, limits, and decision as a monographic case study.

profile_invariants_when_flagged: Every visual and verbal choice traces to a field of the completed declaration.
No field is populated by inference, by another profile, or by this repository's own examples and fixtures.
The five declared semantic values keep one stable meaning across all four surfaces.
The declared action treatment never collides with a declared status value on the same surface.
Declared exclusions are honored without exception.
Type roles resolve to declared families or to documented substitutions, never to silently fetched fonts.
Charts and diagrams function as evidence; color is scarce and carries stable meaning.
hard_gates: Fixture is disclosed as synthetic and no unsupported fact or causal claim is added.
Positive, neutral, and negative remain perceptually distinct and use non-color redundancy.
Semantic mappings remain stable across all four surfaces.
Flagged B resolves every profile choice from a complete declaration and invents none.
B without the activation flag remains brand-neutral and does not leak profile identity.
Responsive renders and all five slides avoid clipping, overflow, and illegible contrast.
Every requested surface, provenance record, render, and QA result exists.
human_gate: The profile owner marks dashboard, decision memo, personal landing, and case-study report as: I would publish this as mine.
